top_signals.title: Goldman Beats on Equity Trading as Fixed Income Falls Short
top_signals.summary: Goldman Sachs Group’s equities traders reported revenue of $6.44 billion for the three months through September, topping expectations. The firm’s fixed-income and rates-trading counterparts fell far below Wall Street’s estimates in the third quarter. Kristine Aquino reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Healey rejects calls to equalise capital gains and income tax rates
top_signals.summary: Chancellor John Healey has reportedly rejected calls by senior Labour figures to raise capital gains tax to the same levels as income tax, after warnings that an increase would harm Britain’s appeal to investors.
